notes: Bengali daily on a custom WordPress-like CMS: per-day archive at /archive/{YYYY-MM-DD}, 12 articles per numbered page (/1==base, tested 12+ pages on 09-25/09-30/10-10/10-20 so first 4 pages = 48 URLs/day, all with that day's pub date); article pages /article/<id> are short URLs, server-rendered full text (samples 2.5k-8.2k chars); robots.txt allows all, sitemap.php is a rolling 1000-URL file covering only ~7 days so it cannot cover the window.
